description: Enum.sort([1, 3, 2], :desc) is [3, 2, 1] in Elixir. fz2 interp (develop e515ae314) compiles it and fails at run time in a closure call: the atom is taken for the sorter function. :asc fails the same way. Elixir also accepts a module (Enum.sort(dates, Date)) and {:asc | :desc, module}; Enum.sort_by/3, min/max and friends take the same sorter forms. Reported by fz-8c; reproduced here.
title: Enum.sort/2 takes :asc and :desc, as in Elixir
